channel.title: PUNICODEX Reliquary
channel.description: Print-on-demand relics of the Unicode Pantheon — apparel, prints, drinkware and relics from the temple collections of the PUNICODEX Reliquary. Every piece is made to order.

item.g:title: Aígyptos Temple Tee
item.g:description: Aígyptos across the chest, the Aígyptos lockup riding the shoulders. Heavyweight organic cotton. Printed on demand by the PUNICODEX Reliquary — made to order, shipped worldwide.

item.g:title: Aígyptos Temple Hoodie
